title: A Glasshouse for the Language
author: Vesper Iversen
blurb: Felix Thackeray, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
